This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellant assailing the impugned award dated 15.11.2017 passed by Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Indore (M.P.) in claim case No.527/2016, whereby an amount of Rs.40,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of filing of claim petition has been awarded.
2.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the amount awarded is on lower side looking to the fact that the appellant has suffered grievous injury which has resulted in disfiguration of the face.
He also submits that the appellant has suffered grievous head injury with fractures at orbital bone where operation done.
He also submits that due to grievous injuries at left maxilla bone a bar fixation done by operation.
Hence it is submitted that appropriate compensation be awarded to the appellant/injured.

Per contra, learned counsel for the Insurance Company submits that learned Claims Tribunal has properly appreciated the evidence available on record and therefore, the impugned award needs no interference.
4. Heard and considered the rival submissions and perused the evidence available on record.
5. Looking to the injuries suffered by the appellant in the accident, period of treatment, age and occupation of the appellant and the fact that the appellant was hospitalized from 3.9.2013 to Mohd Zeeshan vs The National Insurance Company Limited on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18698764/
1 12.9.2013 for operation to be performed, this Court without entering into the merits of the case, is of the considered view that if a lump sum amount of Rs.60,000/- is enhanced that will be just and proper compensation.
6.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, this Misc. Appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation by Rs.60,000/-
over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The other terms and conditions of the impugned award shall remain intact.
